name: Impact
why: A crash, a low boom and a falling hiss on the first beat of a new section. It marks the drop and covers the join.

ingredients.name: A crash
ingredients.adds: One crash cymbal every eight bars, from the default kit.

ingredients.name: A long tail
ingredients.adds: Reverb that carries the crash on for bars.

knobs.label: reverb
knobs.below: It is over in a beat.
knobs.above: A wash under the whole next section.

ingredients.name: A boom underneath
ingredients.adds: A low sine that falls in pitch as it fades.
ingredients.listenFor: The floor drops away under the crash.

knobs.label: boom length
knobs.above: It hums through the next section.

ingredients.name: A falling hiss
ingredients.adds: Noise that gets darker and quieter over the 8 bars: a riser played backwards.

knobs.label: start
knobs.below: A dull whoosh with no sparkle.
